title: Why Property is Still Australia's Best Wealth Vehicle in 2025
excerpt: Despite rising interest rates and market uncertainty, Australian property continues to outperform. Here's why smart investors aren't sitting on the sidelines.
content:
# Why Property is Still Australia's Best Wealth Vehicle in 2025

Despite rising interest rates and market uncertainty, Australian property continues to outperform every major asset class for everyday Australians.

At **est**, we've seen it firsthand. Clients who stayed the course, bought the right assets in the right suburbs, and structured their finance correctly — they're the ones retiring 10 years early.

## The Numbers Don't Lie

Over the past 30 years, Australian residential property has delivered an average annual return of 7.2%. That includes every crash, every rate cycle, every political scare campaign.

## What Most Investors Get Wrong

They chase price growth and ignore yield. They buy in suburbs they've heard of, not suburbs with infrastructure pipelines. They let emotion drive decisions that should be data-driven.

## The est Approach

We use an 8-step property selection criteria that filters out emotion and replaces it with evidence. Location trajectory, rental yield balance, vacancy rates, exit strategy viability — every box gets ticked before we recommend anything.

If you're serious about building wealth through property, stop waiting for the perfect time. The best time to buy was 10 years ago. The second best time is now.

— John Hanna, est Financial
author: John Hanna
